packet.title: fn:transform (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements fn:transform in the XSLT layer: it compiles the stylesheet with xslt.h's compiler, runs it as a unit evaluation, and collects principal and secondary results into the result map.

item.p: Specifications: F&O 4.0, fn:transform (the options map: stylesheet-location, stylesheet-node, stylesheet-text, package-name, initial-mode, initial-template, initial-function, source-node, global-context-item, stylesheet-params, static-params, delivery-format, post-process, requested-properties, and others; the result map of principal and secondary results; FOXT0001 to FOXT0006); XSLT 4.0, 2.3 (initiating a transformation).
Unlocks: XQ40 133 (fn-transform-XSLT; 21 of them ask for XSLT 3.0, which a 4.0 processor serves), XP40 129, and the XT40 transform set (12 cases, 9 failing).
Replaces: the function is absent (XPST0017); supports-dynamic-xslt is false.

Mechanism: the XSLT layer supplies the function, as XQuery supplies fn:load-xquery-module (src/xquery_load_module.c, ). Its body compiles the stylesheet with xslt.h's compiler, then runs the transformation as a unit evaluation with XSLT's (). Result documents are collected into the result map ( raw or as trees). No nested run happens ().

Header: with option 2, xslt.h exports sxml_xslt_transform_feature(), so XPath and XQuery hosts that never name it do not link XSLT. Otherwise none (the XSLT and XQuery processors install it as a layer table).
Size: 10–20 KB in the CLI; 0 in sxml.wasm unless the package names the feature (then about 1.16 MB, measured as XSLT's cost in ).

Gate: ≥ 80 % of the 133 and all 12 XT40 cases. Done 2026-10-19 (): QT4 fn-transform 129 of the 133 run (XQ40; XP40 126 of 130), gate met; XT40 transform 9 of 12, not all: a static fn:transform (transform-004), a ~record pattern (transform-401) and an assertion the driver does not check (transform-009). The rest is 's "Not done".
